governs: What the defective classification method got wrong, constraint by constraint, and how much.

how_much_damage_the_defective_method_did.headline: Seventeen of twenty-seven founder-bound verdicts were wrong about who authored the constraint. Twelve were not founder material at all and five were mislabelled as authority when they were mechanism. Nothing in the assistant-imposed class moved.
how_much_damage_the_defective_method_did.why_the_error_concentrated_where_it_did: The proxy was authority-shaped. A document titled FOUNDER-* and a commit carrying the founder's git identity both look like founder authorship and neither is. Nothing about that proxy could misfire in the direction of calling a real founder statement assistant-authored, so the class it damaged is the only class it could damage - which is also the class where being wrong is most expensive, because a false founder-bound verdict is unappealable by construction.
how_much_damage_the_defective_method_did.the_five_upward_moves_are_not_a_softenin: FB-05, FB-10, FB-16, FB-19 and FB-20 moved from FOUNDER_BOUND to EARNED, which reads like a demotion and is the opposite. Each rested on an attribution and now rests on a receipt. In four of the five the receipt was already in the same register, attached to a different constraint or to none - the defect and the rule it justified sat a few hundred lines apart, unconnected, because the classifier stopped looking once a FOUNDER-* document said the founder had asked for it.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: No founder sentence mentions SW. The pause is recorded only in the third person in an assistant summary. The prior verdict cited that summary as a founder source.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Treated 'the founder paused it' inside a document titled FOUNDER-OPERATING-DIRECTIVES as equivalent to the founder saying so.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: The halt appears in an assistant-authored role-correction receipt carrying an authority label and no founder words. The founder does speak to the adjacent point - he names a desktop app his Chromebook cannot run as an instance of the error class he is correcting - but that governs what may be sent to him, not whether the capability is halted.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Read a receipt's authority.basis field as if it were the utterance the field asserts. Asserting standing is not exhibiting it.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: Unquotable, and the corpus leans the other way: FC-02 says use the ChatGPT account broadly, and FC-01 criticises ChatGPT for over-limiting rather than over-prescribing.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Correctly noticed that the summary scoped this narrowly, then recorded the summary's scope as the founder's scope. The scoping instinct was right; the source was not.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: The number ten appears in no founder sentence. He speaks to scale - 'at the scale I expect' - which supports many projects and no particular count.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Inherited a number from a summary and then reasoned carefully about whether it was a floor or a ceiling, which is a sophisticated argument about an unsourced figure.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: It has a receipt and did not need an attribution. WS-V010-FULLSCALE-CHATGPT was transported by founder-assisted paste and the payload is recorded FAILED_NOT_BYTE_IDENTICAL. The founder was used as a relay and the relay corrupted the payload.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Recorded that exact defect three hundred lines away as EC-11's evidence for a different rule, and classified this one on a summary. The register contained both halves of the correct answer and did not join them.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: No founder sentence states it and no defect names it. The nearest founder material - never treating one thread as the complete founder intent - is a completeness rule, not an authority rule, and is recorded separately as FA-07.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Justified it by pointing at a provider fact about OpenAI conversation-object metadata limits, which supports the rule's wisdom and says nothing about its provenance.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: It is the same rule as EC-24, which the same register classified as EARNED with a live reproduced count of ALIAS_USED_AS_LOCATOR=2.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Classified one rule twice, in two classes, because it encountered it in two files. Read out of a FOUNDER-* document it was founder-bound; read out of currentctl.py it was earned. That is the defective method reduced to a single controlled experiment.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: Expressly voided by the founder by name: 'Protected surfaces is not a founder-established category. I never designated main, PO-03, PR #9 ... as protected.'
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: The known case, and the reason this lane exists. The constraint entered through assistant-drafted commission text in commit 9887f33e, which carries the founder's git identity and also carries 286 lines of Python and tests. The classifier read the identity, found the founder, and certified.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: Its merge clause is contradicted by founder text in four words - 'Merge where merging is right' - which disqualifies a founder-bound verdict outright. Its strategy clause is unquotable but worth keeping, so the record seeks ratification rather than purging.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Accepted a bundle in which an operational prohibition rode on a strategy reservation's obvious rightness. Bundling is how an unsupported clause survives review.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: No founder sentence mentions voice, speech or read-back of speech. One of the seven stages is independently earned and is already classified as EC-23; the other six are unevidenced.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Called it 'load-bearing for the role architecture', which is a reason to want it to be founder-bound rather than a reason to believe it is. Every founder utterance recorded in this estate is text.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: It was built prematurely once and torn out, with a dated receipt: the disclosure-scope correction of 2026-08-22T09:56:42Z records removal of a premature disclosure document, scanners, tests and recurrence-control rows, and a Manus function rolled back to a version without the gate.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Cited a summary while the rollback receipt sat two directories away, unreferenced.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: A dated runtime observation recorded as a standing constraint. Token capacity exhaustion is temporary by construction, and 'the current run' expired when that run did.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Classified a fact as a rule. Its two anti-inference clauses are good reasoning hygiene and bind nothing.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: The reuse-over-duplication half caught a real defect: a duplicate Cursor API key was requested from the founder while one already existed in Supabase Edge Secrets.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Named that very defect in its own AI-02 entry and still classified this rule on an attribution. It also let the non-disclosure half ride on the reuse half's evidence, which is now flagged for ratification rather than carried silently.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: An acceptor refused this programme's own evidence with six criterion FAILs, two of which the root controller then reproduced against its own tooling. It is additionally named by the founder in his 'What stays' paragraph, so it now holds on both grounds.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Sourced it to an exclusion clause in an assistant summary while describing the refusal in the same entry. It had the receipt in hand and filed it under authority.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: Sourced to AGENTS.md, which is repository operator instruction in the estate's own imperative voice with no attributed founder utterance in it. No founder sentence reserves spend, identity, outreach or programme shape to him.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Treated the repository's own instruction file as a founder source. The founder's amendment establishes the opposite relationship: he instructs that his words be appended to AGENTS.md, which makes it a surface he writes onto rather than a record of what he has said.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: Contradicted by founder text on two axes: merging does not need his permission, and a write is gated by reason and rollback rather than by whose decision it is.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Cited an assistant lane's own diagnosis document as the founder source. This is the clearest single instance in the register of a lane's conclusion being recorded as the founder's - the classifier read 'this is founder-bound' in a lane's analysis and entered it as founder-bound.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: Same source problem as FB-21, and two of its seven items are additionally in tension with founder text: it carries the voided word 'protected', and its deletion clause sits against 'Delete where deletion is right and snapshotted.'
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Called this 'the authoritative boundary list' and used it as the standard for removing other constraints that invented stops not on it. A list used as the authority for what counts as founder-bound must itself be founder-traceable.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: Its cited evidence is counterfactual. The register's own words are that 'without it the refusal recorded above could have been amended by the party it refused' - a description of what the control prevents, not a defect it caught. No instance of post-commit verdict mutation is recorded anywhere in this estate.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Labelled it DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED while reproducing nothing. This is the same failure the founder describes, one class over: a control that looked evidenced because it sat among evidenced ones.

verdicts_changed.why_it_changed: It is a named-target prohibition list, which is precisely the shape the founder voided - 'No surface is off-limits because of a name on a list.' Its cited defect, four competing currentness claims, is a condition of the estate that this control did not catch and does not fix.
verdicts_changed.what_the_prior_method_did_wrong: Filed a target prohibition under EARNED, where a de-restriction lane hunting for invented limits would not think to look. The result is a control that forbids writing the exact paths its own expiry condition requires someone to write, indefinitely, with no owner and no date.

verdicts_held_but_restated.from: Do not suppress a high-leverage founder action merely to minimise founder involvement; founder workload must not be artificially minimised.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: A request for the founder to enable, share, confirm or answer something that advances the goal is an authorised form of reply.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: The founder names two acceptable reply shapes and one of them is a request to him. The workload principle came from an assistant-authored authority record. What survives is narrower and more useful: four verbs that describe the authorised founder-action class.

verdicts_held_but_restated.from: No provider holds canonical state. The repository is canonical and models and runtimes must remain substitutable.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: Model and runtime choice is the founder's and remains substitutable. Nothing binds Obzio to Claude, Cursor or any provider.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: The substitutability half is founder-authored in one sentence. The canonical-store designation is not in the corpus and does not need to be - it is carried by EC-18 and EC-21, which reproduced it.

verdicts_held_but_restated.from: Never create an exclusive dependency on Cursor or SW.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: No architecture creates an exclusive dependency on a provider. Every role names a substitution route, because nothing binds Obzio to Claude, Cursor or any provider.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: The only widening in the register. 'Any provider' reaches the platforms not yet chosen, which is the case the rule exists for; naming two was an artefact of which platforms were in view when the summary was written.

verdicts_held_but_restated.from: Do not bind a named tool, model or architecture without a founder decision.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: Binding a model or runtime is a founder decision. Recommending, qualifying, dry-running and specifying one are not.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: 'Model and runtime choice is mine' is direct. 'Named tool' and 'architecture' are surplus, and the surplus mattered: architecture binding covers most of what the operating-environment commission asks Cursor to do, so it quietly reserved the deliverable to the founder.

verdicts_held_but_restated.from: Every reply or turn must end with a changed live operation or an immediately launchable executable, plus evidence. A register-only, receipt-only, schema-only, test-only or automation-only turn fails.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: A run that touched nothing and produced nothing has passed nothing. Every return reports what was written, where, why, on what evidence, and how to reverse it.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: Founder-authored twice over in the amendment. The enumeration of forbidden artifact types is assistant-authored and, taken literally, wrong: a test-only turn that changes a live gate has touched something and passes his test.

verdicts_held_but_restated.direction: narrowed on one axis, widened on another
verdicts_held_but_restated.from: Cursor is the current strategic operator interface for this scope, not the permanent brain and not the canonical state store.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: Cursor's role is short-term: a Strategic Lead, Coordinator and Operator establishing a temporary strategic coordination layer that operates Obzio until the internal open-source model system is running.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: The founder supplies the termination condition the prior wording left implicit, and a larger role than 'operator interface' - his words are Strategic Lead / Coordinator / Operator, 'along with whatever else we can utilize within our capacity'. The canonical-store clause moves to EC-18 and EC-21.

verdicts_held_but_restated.from: Nothing is deleted. Superseded files remain evidence; add an explicit disposition rather than removing unique evidence.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: Reversibility gate: snapshot before an irreversible write - tag, archive, recorded SHA. Delete where deletion is right and snapshotted. That is custody, not protection.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: The largest substantive change in the register that does not move a class. The prior statement was an absolute prohibition on deletion; the founder authorises deletion and requires a snapshot. A diff reporting only class movement would miss this entirely, which is why provctl reports restatements separately. The absolute was also expensive: an estate that may not delete accumulates 80 abandoned tips and 65 orphaned lease refs and then needs a second mechanism to exclude them from its own denominator.

verdicts_held_but_restated.from: Produce a comprehensive staged programme and guide the founder through it incrementally, with a deliberate stop/evaluate gate at each consequential choice point, and discuss consequential alternatives before freezing them.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: Produce the best guide to the current Cursor interface and setup that allows the founder to launch the way he wants, at the scale he expects, with the results he expects. If such a guide already exists, direct him to it.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: The deliverable is founder-authored in one sentence; the staging apparatus is not. The surplus is worth naming precisely: the prior register removed AI-01, a structurally identical stage gate, as assistant-imposed in the same document that retained this one as founder-bound. Two stage gates, one classified each way, distinguished only by which file each was read out of.

verdicts_held_but_restated.from: Return no founder action until the relevant assumptions are verified.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: An action resting on an unverified device, plan or account fact is not ready to send the founder. Actions carry evidence labels exactly as claims do.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: Founder-authored almost verbatim, with both instances supplied by him. The labelling requirement is the mechanism half of the same sentence and the prior wording dropped it. The estate labels claims and does not yet label actions; that gap is named by the founder and is not closed here.

verdicts_held_but_restated.from: Write scope is fenced client-side, per lane, by a refusing hook rather than by prose.
verdicts_held_but_restated.to: Write scope is fenced client-side, per lane, by a refusing hook rather than by prose. The hook checks that a write was declared and reasoned, not that its target avoided a forbidden list.
verdicts_held_but_restated.why: The founder retains the guard and changes what it checks, in one sentence. It is the clearest illustration in the corpus of his authority-versus-mechanism distinction: the mechanism stays, the denylist it consulted goes. Any implementation still testing a forbidden-path list is enforcing FB-11 under another name.

added_by_this_lane.why_adding_is_in_scope: The founder instructs that every constraint in force be classified. A founder-authored constraint that no register captured is a constraint in force with no class, which his rule makes unenforceable. Ten were recovered from the corpus; every one is quotation-backed and none was present in the prior register in any class.

constraints.recovers: Every surface in the estate is writable; no surface is off-limits by name. The positive replacement for FB-11 - a void leaves a hole a later lane fills with the same habit, and a stated permission does not.
The concurrency gate. Founder-authored ground for EC-01 and EC-10.
The evidence gate. Founder-authored ground for manifest closure, read-back and the admission ladder, and the reason removing the target list costs nothing in safety.
Inaction is not a deliverable; the specific sentence 'protected surfaces verified unchanged' is removed as a success criterion.
An unclassified constraint is not in force. The rule this register executes, which had to be in the register.
The symmetry clause. The brake on this lane, and why nothing structural is discarded.

The whole authorised ChatGPT account may be used broadly, preserving provenance, with no thread treated as complete intent. The prior register held only the negations of this - AI-06 and AI-07 - so the estate recorded what ChatGPT may not be reduced to and never recorded what it may do.
Preserve meaning through handoffs; assistant summaries must never distort founder intent. Founder-authored, and older than the defect it describes.
Provider defaults and product caution habits do not define Obzio's boundaries. The generalisation of the protected-surface correction beyond branch names.
The planner framing is void, and granted permissions are used at maximum capacity without re-asking.

what_did_not_move_and_why_that_matters.assistant_imposed: All 22 prior ASSISTANT_IMPOSED verdicts hold at ASSISTANT_AUTHORED. Several are now condemned by founder text rather than by inference: AI-06 and AI-07 by FC-02's instruction to use the ChatGPT account broadly, AI-10 by 'A run that touched nothing and produced nothing has passed nothing', AI-11 by FC-09's rule on product caution habits.
what_did_not_move_and_why_that_matters.earned: 25 of 27 prior EARNED_CONTROL verdicts hold, and eight are additionally named by the founder in his 'What stays' paragraph, so they now rest on a receipt and a ratification rather than on a receipt alone.
what_did_not_move_and_why_that_matters.the_signal: A method that damaged one class and left the other two intact was not producing noise. It was producing a systematic error in exactly the direction its proxy could err, which is why the error was invisible from inside the method and obvious from outside it.
